provenance: Moods, colours and messages copied from the public configuration the live mood check-in reads (Apps Script feed, read 2026-10-19). Emoji kept as decoration only; the label is what is announced.

moods.label: Burnt out
messages: Sounds like your energy is running low today. Be kind to yourself.
Rest is still part of getting through the week.
A slower day is still a valid day.

moods.label: Overloaded
messages: That is a lot at once. One thing at a time is enough.
You do not have to solve everything today.
Take a breath. The next small step still counts.

moods.label: Finding calm
messages: Glad things are feeling a little lighter right now.
Hope you get to hold onto that calm for a while.
A steady moment can make a real difference.

moods.label: Getting there
messages: You are making progress, even if it feels gradual.
Keep going. Small steps still move you forward.
You do not have to have it all figured out yet.

moods.label: Thriving
messages: Love to hear that things are going well today.
Keep enjoying the good moments when they come.
Glad today is treating you well.

after: Peer support groups are entirely drop-in. No sign-up, no commitment, come alone or bring a friend!
